sourceEvidence.title: Plant Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
**The Contribution You'll bring to this Role:**

The Plant Manager is a strategic plant leadership role accountable for the safe, efficient, and compliant operation of one of the Justrite sites responsible for metal fabrication. This role leads daily execution across Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and People (SQDCP) and ensures finished goods are produced to plan to support customer service and inventory targets.

The Plant Manager partners closely with Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, and EHS to stabilize schedules, improve throughput, reduce scrap and rework, and sustain standard work. While there is no centralized warehouse, the Plant Manager ensures effective on-site staging, WIP control, and shipping coordination to support on-time delivery.

**About the Team:**

As a member of our **Operations** team, you will be dedicated to driving efficiency and excellence across all aspects of our business. With a focus on streamlined processes and innovative solutions, they ensure that our operations run smoothly and effectively. Comprised of skilled professionals who are leaders in their field, the team is committed to optimizing performance and delivering high-quality results. Their expertise is key to maintaining our competitive edge and supporting the growth and success of our company.

**What You'll Do at Justrite:**

**Safety, Environmental, and Compliance**

* Own site safety performance: eliminate hazards, strengthen near-miss reporting, and ensure timely corrective action closure.

* Ensure compliance with OSHA/local regulations, required training, PPE, and audit readiness.

* Lead incident investigations and implement sustainable countermeasures.

**Operations and Delivery Performance**

* Deliver daily and weekly production plan attainment while maintaining schedule stability and rapid issue escalation.

* Manage labor and staffing plans (shift coverage, overtime, cross-training) to meet output and service-level targets.

* Coordinate shipping priorities and finished goods readiness with Customer Service and Supply Chain.

**Quality and Process Control**

* Ensure product conformance to specifications; partner with Quality on containment, root cause, and corrective actions.

* Reduce scrap and rework through process controls, mistake-proofing, training, and layered process audits as applicable.

**Reliability and Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with Maintenance to drive preventive maintenance compliance, uptime, and reliability improvements (TPM where applicable).

* Lead Lean/CI initiatives (5S, standard work, setup reduction, flow improvements) across fabrication and machining.

* Use data-driven problem solving (A3, 5-Why) to improve throughput, OEE, and constraint performance.

**People Leadership and Cost Management**

* Create and deliver on operational plans to achieve budget

* Develop and coach supervisors, managers, and team leads; set expectations, build accountability, and strengthen engagement.

* Own controllable cost drivers (labor, overtime, scrap/rework, supplies) and deliver annual operating plan targets.

* Identify and justify capital, tooling, and automation opportunities with strong ROI.

**Key Interfaces**

* Supply Chain (S&OP, production planning, material availability, inventory targets, expedites)

* Quality (supplier/customer issues, corrective actions, audits)

* Engineering (process improvements, routings/BOM alignment, tooling/fixtures)

* Maintenance (preventive maintenance, downtime root cause, reliability)

* EHS (training, compliance, risk assessments)

**Key Performance Indicators (Typical)**

* Safety: TRIR/recordables, near-miss reporting, corrective action closure

* Delivery: schedule attainment, plan adherence, on-time shipment performance

* Quality: scrap and rework rates, customer complaints/returns, internal defect rate

* Productivity: OEE or key equipment uptime, labor efficiency, throughput, setup/changeover time

* Cost: overtime, conversion cost per unit, premium freight driven by site issues

* People: turnover/attendance, training completion, engagement actions
